{{- /* layouts/_partials/graph.html Knowledge graph visualization (D3.js + PixiJS) (v2.2+). Activation: [params] graph = true in config.toml Requires: params.search.content = true (provides link[] data for edges) Locked contract: #graph-container ID (D3/PixiJS mounts here) CSS customization: override --mdf-graph-* variables in sub-theme main.css Config tuning (optional) when graph is an object: [params.graph] depth = 1 local = true global = false repelForce = 0.5 centerForce = 0.3 linkDistance = 30 Quartz sub-themes: use quartz/graph.html instead (legacy UI + data-cfg). */ -}} {{- if .Site.Params.graph -}} {{- $depth := 1 -}} {{- $local := true -}} {{- $global := false -}} {{- $repelForce := 0.5 -}} {{- $centerForce := 0.3 -}} {{- $linkDistance := 30 -}} {{- $graphCfg := .Site.Params.graph -}} {{- if reflect.IsMap $graphCfg -}} {{- $depth = $graphCfg.depth | default 1 -}} {{- $local = $graphCfg.local | default true -}} {{- $global = $graphCfg.global | default false -}} {{- $repelForce = $graphCfg.repelForce | default 0.5 -}} {{- $centerForce = $graphCfg.centerForce | default 0.3 -}} {{- $linkDistance = $graphCfg.linkDistance | default 30 -}} {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
